review_description: When looking for solar panels, I was overwhelmed with the choice, found it difficult to trust some companies, and was worried I would not get value for money.Dealing with Green 4 Life has been so simple. I had a complete understanding of the product I was purchasing, and was made aware of different options available to suit my Family and budget. The contract was explained in detail, and once we saw the savings we had to go ahead.Installation was one day, and the workmanship is incredible. Not only are we saving hugely on our electric bills, the panels look stylish on our home. I would recommend Green 4 life, 100%

The quality of the products used and the craftsmanship of the installation is top-notch. We feel confident that our investment in solar energy was well worth it.We highly recommend Green 4 Life Oz to anyone looking to switch to solar power. They exceeded our expectations in every way and we are grateful for their expertise and dedication to helping us go green. Thank you Vish and the team, for a job well done!

Got a couple of quotes and even with one in Sydney being half the price I knew Green4LifeOz were the right choice.  I knew exactly what I was getting and what I was paying.  The designer came out prior to installation to inspect the roof and meter box rather than a bunch of cowboys turning up on the day (more common than you would believe) and the process was simple and straightforward. If the ROI promised is less than 2-3 years - RUN. As a qualified electrician myself, I have no idea why people go cheap and wonder why they have been burned. Just Go local. Thanks James & the boys - Great work!

Went local with Green4LifeOz and so happy we did. Well explained at point of sale by James - high quality equipment, their own installers and at a fair price. Would recommend to others.
